title: NeuroPlay — 32 Age-Differentiated Game Questions
age_selection_rule: Select the question IDs in age_group_question_ids for the child's age band, then use that question's matching difficulty_by_age version.

metrics_definition.clicks: Number of interactions/clicks made during the task.
metrics_definition.hits: Correct responses or correctly completed items.
metrics_definition.score: Points according to the task scoring rule.
metrics_definition.accuracy: Correct responses divided by attempted responses; define handling of zero attempts in code.
metrics_definition.miss_rate: Incorrect responses divided by attempted responses; define handling of zero attempts in code.
metrics_definition.completion_time_ms: Time from task display to submission, in milliseconds.
metrics_definition.attempts: Number of tries made by the participant.

important_note: This is a prototype question bank for educational/research screening, not a clinically validated dyslexia diagnostic test. Use accessible, language-appropriate items and validate with qualified professionals before making screening claims. Age-group counts: 27 questions for ages 7-8, 30 for ages 9-12, and 32 for ages 13-17. Current sets use Q1-Q27, Q1-Q30, and Q1-Q32 respectively; review age appropriateness with reading specialists before piloting.
